استؤذنت (form X)
# اُسْتُؤْذِنْتُ (ustuʔḏintu) /us.tuʔ.ðin.tu/: first-person singular past passive of اِسْتَأْذَنَ (istaʔḏana)
# اُسْتُؤْذِنْتَ (ustuʔḏinta) /us.tuʔ.ðin.ta/: second-person masculine singular past passive of اِسْتَأْذَنَ (istaʔḏana)
# اُسْتُؤْذِنْتِ (ustuʔḏinti) /us.tuʔ.ðin.ti/: second-person feminine singular past passive of اِسْتَأْذَنَ (istaʔḏana)
# اُسْتُؤْذِنَتْ (ustuʔḏinat) /u
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
